proposals.subject: DispatcherConfig cold-load staging fields
proposals.current_state: FR-018 describes DispatcherConfig as a 14-field config; struct now has 16 fields (cold_staging_slots default 64, cold_staging_buf_bytes default 4 MiB) which are undocumented.
proposals.proposed_fr_text: The dispatcher SHALL maintain a bounded pool of pre-registered pinned host DRAM staging buffers for SSD->GPU cold loads that cannot obtain a memory-tier slot under pressure, sized by DispatcherConfig::cold_staging_slots (buffer count, default 64; 0 disables staging so cold loads fail on a full memory tier) and DispatcherConfig::cold_staging_buf_bytes (per-buffer byte capacity, must be >= the largest per-block transfer size, default 4 MiB), bounding concurrent cold-read parallelism so a burst cannot exhaust the memory tier.
proposals.rationale: Additive fields with defaults; backward compatible via Default. Backfilled spec predates the multi-GPU cold-staging work.

proposals.subject: IGpuServices multi-GPU device routing methods
proposals.current_state: FR-011 lists IGpuServices methods but omits set_device and device_of_ptr.
proposals.proposed_fr_text: IGpuServices SHALL provide set_device(device: i32) -> Result<(), String> to bind the calling OS thread's current CUDA device (CUDA tracks the current device per thread; required before creating a stream or issuing a DMA for a specific GPU) and device_of_ptr(ptr: *const c_void) -> Result<i32, String> to return the CUDA device ordinal owning a device pointer via cudaPointerGetAttributes (-1 for a pointer with no device association, e.g. host memory), so DMAs can be routed to a stream on the pointer's own device under multi-GPU / tensor parallelism.
spec_updates: Append to FR-011: set_device(&self, device: i32) -> Result<(), String> - Select the calling thread's current CUDA device.
Append to FR-011: device_of_ptr(&self, ptr: *const c_void) -> Result<i32, String> - Return the CUDA device ordinal owning a device pointer (-1 if unknown).
proposals.rationale: Additive trait methods for multi-GPU routing; no existing method changed.

proposals.subject: Completion enum Clone derive (entity-attribute note)
proposals.current_state: Completion changed from #[derive(Debug)] to #[derive(Debug, Clone)]; FR-017 and NFR-003 do not record the Clone capability.
proposals.proposed_fr_text: Completion: 10-variant enum for operation results; derives Clone (in addition to Debug) so the block-device actor can try_send a clone of a completion on a full ring without consuming the original, enabling non-blocking completion delivery.
spec_updates: Amend FR-017 Completion bullet with the Clone note above.
Amend NFR-003 to note Completion is Send + Clone (Command remains Send).
proposals.rationale: Small additive derive; enables non-blocking delivery without altering thread-safety guarantees.
